en.title: The Peaceful King of the Savanna
en.content: In the shade of an ancient baobab tree, a majestic lion rests peacefully. Neale's pencil captured the quiet dignity of this king of beasts - not fierce or roaring, but calm and contemplative. The detailed shading shows the texture of the lion's magnificent mane and the weathered bark of the old tree that has provided shelter for countless generations. This isn't a story of hunting or danger, but of harmony between the mighty lion and his leafy companion. The tree's branches seem to embrace the lion protectively, while the lion's presence guards the tree from harm. Together, they represent the perfect balance of strength and gentleness that exists in nature's most peaceful moments.

zh.title: 草原上的和平之王
zh.content: 在古老猴面包树的阴影下，一只威严的狮子安静地休息着。恩恩的铅笔捕捉到了这位兽王安静的尊严——不是凶猛或咆哮，而是平静和沉思。细致的阴影显示了狮子壮丽鬃毛的质感和为无数代提供庇护的老树风化的树皮。这不是一个关于狩猎或危险的故事，而是关于威严的狮子与他的绿叶伙伴之间和谐相处的故事。树枝似乎保护性地拥抱着狮子，而狮子的存在也保护着树免受伤害。它们一起代表了自然最和平时刻中力量与温柔的完美平衡。
